a(\\d)+c	abq	no-match	dot=false
a(\\d)+c	axy zc	no-match	dot=false
a(\\d)+c	axy	no-match	dot=false
a(\\d)+c	axy.zc	no-match	dot=false
a(\\d)+c	axyzc	no-match	dot=false
a(\\d)+c	^abc$	no-match	dot=false
(\\d)+	foo@#$%123ASD #$$%^&	no-match	dot=false
(\\d)+	foo!@#$asdfl;	no-match	dot=false
a(\\D)+c	a123c	no-match	dot=false

## micromatch.special_characters_slashes_should_match_forward_slashes
/	/	match	dot=false

## micromatch.special_characters_colons_and_drive_letters_should_treat
:	:	match	dot=false
:/*	:/foo	match	dot=false
D://*	D://foo	match	dot=false

## micromatch.special_characters_ab_brackets_should_support_regex
a/[A-Z].md	a/b.md	no-match	dot=false
a/[A-Z].md	a/c.md	no-match	dot=false
a/[A-Z].md	a/d.md	no-match	dot=false
a/[A-Z].md	a/E.md	match	dot=false
a/[bd].md	a/b.md	match	dot=false
a/[bd].md	a/c.md	no-match	dot=false
a/[bd].md	a/d.md	match	dot=false
a-[2-4].md	a-1.md	no-match	dot=false
a-[2-4].md	a-2.md	match	dot=false
a-[2-4].md	a-3.md	match	dot=false
a-[2-4].md	a-4.md	match	dot=false
a-[2-4].md	a-5.md	no-match	dot=false
[bc]/[bd].md	a/b.md	no-match	dot=false
[bc]/[bd].md	b/b.md	match	dot=false
[bc]/[bd].md	c/b.md	match	dot=false
[bc]/[bd].md	b/c.md	no-match	dot=false
[bc]/[bd].md	a/d.md	no-match	dot=false

## micromatch.special_characters_dollar_should_match_dollar_signs
!$	$	no-match	dot=false

*	$$	match	dot=false

*	^	match	dot=false

*$*	$	match	dot=false
*$*	$$	match	dot=false
*$*	$$$	match	dot=false

*$	$	match	dot=false
*$	$$	match	dot=false
*$	$$$	match	dot=false
*$	^	no-match	dot=false
?$	$	no-match	dot=false
?$	$$	match	dot=false
?$	$$$	no-match	dot=false
?$	^	no-match	dot=false

a/*.txt	a/x/y.txt	no-match	dot=false
a/*.txt	a/x/y/z	no-match	dot=false
a*.txt	a.txt	match	dot=false
a*.txt	a/b.txt	no-match	dot=false
a*.txt	a/x/y.txt	no-match	dot=false
a*.txt	a/x/y/z	no-match	dot=false
*.txt	a.txt	match	dot=false
*.txt	a/b.txt	no-match	dot=false
*.txt	a/x/y.txt	no-match	dot=false
*.txt	a/x/y/z	no-match	dot=false

## micromatch.stars_single_stars_should_correctly_match_slashes

*/*/	foo/bar	no-match	dot=false

*/**	foo/	match	dot=false
**/*	foo/bar	match	dot=false
*/*	foo/bar	match	dot=false
*/**	foo/bar	match	dot=false
**/	foo/bar/	match	dot=false
**/*/	foo/bar/	match	dot=false
*/**	foo/bar/	match	dot=false
*/*/	foo/bar/	match	dot=false

## micromatch.stars_single_stars_should_optionally_match_trailing_slashes

**/*{,/}	foo/bar	match	dot=false
